This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and colorful [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], numerous members of this species could be found in the city [[Wrils]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]], serving who was believed to be [[Jeodu]] criminal [[Dequc]], though it turned out to only be a decoy.<ref name="MJ2" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 2|second issue]]<ref name="MJ2" /> of the [[1998]]<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/97-640/Star-Wars-Mara-Jade---By-The-Emperors-Hand-2-of-6|text=Star Wars: Mara Jade - By The Emperor's Hand #2 (of 6)}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]'' series of comics, written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and [[Michael A. Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ2" />
